kappa_t: t^-2 - t^-1, with t the character of the obstruction component (equal to 2 at t = -1)
R1_pinning: four-way algebra: exact counts of lifting class data on K and K # K (K = 6_1 at (p, d) = (5, 4), (7, 3); 3_1 at (7, 6)). At slope d/p the count on K # K is the square of the count on K in all three cases; at slope d/1 it differs from the square in at least one case (a cross-summand channel).
R2_local_forms: (a) the chiral knots 3_1, 5_2, 6_1, 7_5, 8_5 obstruct (32 random class data, lift fraction < 1) at each listed (p, d) and root; (b) the negative amphichiral knots 4_1, 6_3, 8_9, 8_17, 8_18 never obstruct at any root of order at least 3 for p in {7, 11, 13, 17, 19}, for the four-way algebra, the pair-quotient F3 of free class 3 on (a, -a), and the class-4 algebra layer4; (c) the (k,1)-cables of T(2,p) at (p, d, k) in {(5,4,2), (13,4,2), (7,6,3), (13,6,3), (11,10,5), (13,12,6), (17,8,4)} have roots exactly at the characters with t^k = -1 and never obstruct there, for four-way, F3, layer4 and the pair-failing free class 3 on (a, a).
R3_steering: on connected sums of summands with vanishing local forms (6_3, 8_17, 4_1; (2,1)- and (3,1)-cables of T(2,p)) with one cable_d(P4) insertion: the base form is zero and the change of the obstruction pairing at every odd component of layers 3 and 4 equals kappa_t sum_j <W_j^(3)(leaves)>_comp ell_j(s), leaves = sum_i t^(d-1-i) c_i over the d bundle strands (reverse-order product), the data including free layer-2 classes; insertions leave the cocycle spaces unchanged; (J_t^T 1, 0) annihilates every obstruction vector.
R4_gadgets: gadget surgeries (K2, P3, K3 at (7,3) on 6_3; P3 at (13,4) and K2 at (7,6) on cables): the measured form equals kappa_t times the sum over edges of the P4 form of the leaves, for four-way and layer4, and the vertex leaf reads X_v - X_u exactly at every character.
